title: Proofmesh repository conventions 0.1
description: Types only the repository can name, for rules that ship with an adapter: job base classes, feature flag keys, and the enum whose members name owning teams. Data, not code: registering a conventions file runs nothing. Type names are qualified, with or without type parameters.

jobs.description: Every concrete class deriving from a base type is a job that runs it.

feature_flags.description: Feature flag keys: string constants declared in a class, or members of a key type created with a constant key. Code reading a key evaluates the flag.

teams.description: An enum whose members name teams: code passing a member as an argument, optionally only to a parameter of the given name, is owned by that team.
